:::{#sol-held-out-unbiased}

Given $\mathcal{T}$, the rule $\fitted$ is fixed.
Each held-out pair has the same distribution as $(X_0, Y_0)$
and is independent of $\mathcal{T}$,
so each squared prediction error has conditional expectation
$\E{\prederr_{0,j}^2 \mid \mathcal{T}} = \generr_{\mathcal{T}}$
by @eq-generalization-error.
Then

$$
\ba
\E{\frac{1}{m} \sum_{j=1}^m \prederr_{0,j}^2 \mid \mathcal{T}}
&= \frac{1}{m} \E{\sum_{j=1}^m \prederr_{0,j}^2 \mid \mathcal{T}}
&& \text{(factor out the constant } 1/m \text{)}
\\
&= \frac{1}{m} \sum_{j=1}^m \E{\prederr_{0,j}^2 \mid \mathcal{T}}
&& \text{(expectation of a sum)}
\\
&= \frac{1}{m} \sum_{j=1}^m \generr_{\mathcal{T}}
&& \text{(each term, as above)}
\\
&= \frac{1}{m} \cdot m \, \generr_{\mathcal{T}}
&& \text{(sum of } m \text{ equal terms)}
\\
&= \generr_{\mathcal{T}}
&& (\tfrac{1}{m} \cdot m = 1)
\ea
$$

The third line is the one that needs the held-out set
to be independent of $\mathcal{T}$.

:::
